newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC board agrees sale of energy unit.
newsitem.headline: PNOC board agrees sale of energy unit.

text.p: The board of the Philippine National Oil Co (PNOC) has approved the sale of 60 percent of its subsidiary, the PNOC-Energy Development Corp (PNOC-EDC), an official said.

Energy Minister and PNOC chairman Francisco Viray told a news briefing on Wednesday that 30 to 40 percent of the company's shares will be sold to the public in an initial public offering (IPO) while the remaining shares will be sold to strategic investors.

Viray said PNOC's financial advisor, the consortium of Morgan Stanley, Development Bank of the Philippines and the Land Bank of the Philippines, recommended that the government should retain a 40 percent stake in the company.
Viray said the privatisation scheme for PNOC-EDC is being reveiwed by the state-agency Committee on Privatisation.
PNOC-EDC operates and maintains most of the country's geothermal power plants.
